Occurrences.Kwic: 根身器界是。四百四病是。山河大地是。見聞知覺是。以至一切差別塵緣無有不是者。咄是何言歟。且四大五隂及差別塵緣等。皆是敗壞不安之相。若喚作安閑法。大似指鹿為馬。若不喚作安閑法。亦是指鹿為馬。直饒去此二途別資一路。未免亦是指鹿為馬。要得不指鹿為馬。須是向他真歇和尚未啟口已前。

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB197.xml). Essentials of the Recorded Sayings of Master Wu Yi of Boshan. Senses.Explanation: A spit in four graphs: nothing just said survives it. The hall spends it on the Buddha's own awakening line, on Zhaozhou's answer, on flattery of the founder — and then answers on its own feet. Dismissal of the highest: Baiyu Jingsi raises the awakening line — strange, that all beings have the thus-come one's wisdom and virtue-attributes, only deluded grasping keeping them from attesting it — shouts, and asks what talk is this: the great and small World-Honored with eyes empty of the four seas and no one beside him, talk good only for crowding the crowd and fooling the foolish, hard to escape inspection two thousand years on; Lüyan He raises Zhaozhou's answer to the wrong-road ask — know the mind, see the nature, no wrong road — spits twice and asks what talk is this: great and small Zhaozhou still holding the lecture-master's view, and were he asked, he would say only, go straight ahead; Zhongfeng Mingben runs the list — the four elements are it, the four hundred four illnesses are it, mountains and rivers, seeing and hearing, everything without exception — then spits on his own identification: call it the ease-teaching and you are calling a deer a horse. The polite and the local spits: Miyun Yuanwu, walking with his teacher as the stone lurched and stepping up to steady it, is asked whether he means to support him — what talk is that, he answers; Tianyin Yuanxiu defends Shenxiu, whose polishing verse was ruled a common fool's clinging-to-being: to make Master Xiu out a common fool — what talk is that! — and he brings in Nanyue's something-to-say; Yulin Tongxiu, when someone calls the founder's showing of his own face a wasting of people, spits: what talk is that!; Wuyi Yuanlai mounts the high seat at the great feast of the teaching — what teaching will be taught? The freeing? The unthinkable? The gate of not-two? The show of powers? Spit! What talk is that! — and after the long silence: Vimalakirti has come, greet him; Baichi Xingyuan gives Lord Luo's birthday ask of the fine thread and the old road, holds the silence, shouts once — what talk is that! — and steps down.
